blocks.text: Mechanical wooden kits, automata, magic tricks and puzzle boxes

blocks.content:
Hello, I am Shasa Bolton, the designer behind Contraption Cart. I am a mechanical engineer with a passion for mechanisms and objects of curiosity. On my shop page you will find items such as automata, puzzle boxes, magic tricks amd mechanical toys. Many come either fully assembled, or as DIY kits 

I also work on commissioned mechanical sculpture, animatronics and product design, many of which can be seen on my projects page.

blocks.text: Browse the shop for magic tricks, puzzle boxes, automata, and more.
